full_judgment: 2A. One Haripada Roy Chowdhury as plaintiff instituted Title Suit No. 1 of 1976 in the First Court of Sub-ordinate Judge, Comilla for declaring the irrevocable General Power of Attorney dated 26-1-64 executed by him in favour of defendant No. 2 as forged and also for a declaration that the exchange deed alleged to have been executed by the defendant No. 2 in favour of the petitioner as defendant No. 1 is void, illegal, collusive inoperative, fraudulent and without consideration and for recovery of khas possession and eviction of defendant No. 1 (petitioner) therefrom. The defendant-petitioner has raised a serious question as to the identity of the plaintiff but it has not been stated whether she has filed any written statement.
